items.quote: We're looking for a Senior or Staff Fullstack Engineer
Own features from concept through production across React/TypeScript, Python and Rust

items.value: Fast React and TypeScript front end
items.quote: Build responsive and high-performance user experiences using React and TypeScript

items.value: Bring AI agents and ML into the product
items.quote: Integrate AI agents and machine learning services into real product workflows
Contribute to Python and Rust services responsible for business logic, data exchange, agent orchestration and communication with the client application
Design and evolve API contracts alongside platform and backend engineers
Integrate third-party platforms and APIs while accounting for authentication, rate limits, retries, latency and failures
Work with streaming and real-time data, ensuring results are delivered reliably and efficiently to the browser
Investigate performance across the entire application, from browser memory and rendering through API calls and backend services
Write maintainable, well-tested code, contribute to code reviews

items.value: Senior or Staff, production web apps
items.quote: You've already worked at Senior or Staff level building sophisticated web applications used in production
Strong React and TypeScript experience
Experience working with WebAssembly in the browser
Experience integrating LLMs, AI agents or similar AI services into production applications
including streaming responses, tool calls, unpredictable latency, errors and partial results
Experience integrating external APIs and designing around authentication, rate limiting, retries and service failures
Strong debugging skills across the stack
Good knowledge of front-end architecture and patterns for building complex, stateful applications
Production experience with at least one of our backend languages: Python or Rust
Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your normal engineering workflow
The communication skills to work effectively across engineering, product, design and machine learning teams

items.value: At ease in an evolving codebase
items.quote: comfortable joining an evolving product and codebase where not every problem has already been neatly defined
2D or 3D graphics, CAD or geometry-heavy applications
WebGL, WebGPU or Three.js
AWS infrastructure and managed services
Production observability, including logging, tracing and monitoring
CI/CD and GitLab pipelines
Agile product development
The role has a strong front-end focus
You'll also work closely with machine learning engineers

dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.question: How does work reach this engineer: a ready ticket, a problem statement, or an idea to shape with product?

dimensions.name: Risk / Experimentation
dimensions.question: How much room is there to try a new approach in production, say a different agent pattern, and who signs it off?

evidence.quote: Own features from concept through production
evidence.reading: Owns a feature from idea to production

evidence.quote: not every problem has already been neatly defined
evidence.reading: Starts from problems that are not yet defined

evidence.quote: Collaborate directly with product managers, designers, ML engineers and other software engineers
evidence.reading: Works directly with product, design and ML

evidence.quote: you like understanding how the whole product works
evidence.reading: Expected to understand the whole product

dimensions.name: Execution Style
dimensions.question: Does the team ship early and iterate in production, or plan a feature through before it goes out?

dimensions.name: Domain Orientation
dimensions.question: How close to the customers' own work does this engineer need to get: talking to users, or building from what product writes down?

dimensions.name: Challenge / Conflict
dimensions.question: At Staff level, how much should this person push back on product and architecture decisions, and with whom?

evidence.quote: Experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of your normal engineering workflow
evidence.reading: AI tools are part of the daily workflow

evidence.quote: willing to move between React, APIs, backend services and AI systems
evidence.reading: Moves between front end, services and AI

contradictions.note: Open at Senior or Staff level, with a scope described as owning features. Worth confirming what would make the hire Staff here: a wider scope, or the same scope with more experience.
quotes: We're looking for a Senior or Staff Fullstack Engineer
Own features from concept through production across React/TypeScript, Python and Rust

contradictions.note: WebAssembly in the browser is required, while graphics, CAD and geometry work is a nice-to-have. Worth confirming what the WebAssembly modules do, in case the two go together.
quotes: Experience working with WebAssembly in the browser
2D or 3D graphics, CAD or geometry-heavy applications

contradictions.note: The role has a strong front-end focus, yet is not for someone who wants only front-end tickets. Worth confirming roughly how the time splits between the browser and the services.
quotes: The role has a strong front-end focus
You probably won't enjoy this position if you want to work exclusively on isolated front-end tickets
